subject: How to compute Mass Percentage of Home Range Density Overlapping with Shape File

messages.author: a490904b71377e0e
messages.subject: How to compute Mass Percentage of Home Range Density Overlapping with Shape File
parts:
Hi Chris, 

Everything is in the title, i have created a UD object, but I want to know the percentage of the entire mass distribution that lies inside a shape file I have. Do you know a way to extract the home range density as a spatial object and a function to compute the overlap percentage? 

I check on the web but didn't find something doing it precisely on R. 

Do you know how to do it based on these UD objects?

Thank you in advance,

Maxime

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: How to compute Mass Percentage of Home Range Density Overlapping with Shape File
parts:
Hi Maxime,

You want to export the probability mass function (PMF), and then sum those pixels in the area of interest.

https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/export.html

Best,
Chris
